premises.text: Music online increases spending, time-in-venue, and brand perception, but licensing popular music is a legal nightmare for product builders
premises.evidence_span: using music online increases spending, it increases the time in the venue, and it even improves the perception of the brand. But the unfortunate truth is that using music online is a legal nightmare

premises.text: Feed.fm provides a legal turnkey way to add popular music via a simple API and JavaScript, iOS, and Unity SDKs, including Shopify and WordPress paths
premises.evidence_span: We provide a legal turnkey way to add popular music to your website, app, or game

premises.text: An on-site/in-app HTML5 player keeps users on the product (no pop-up players or off-site listening) to increase session time
premises.evidence_span: there's no need for messy pop-up players or the need, God forbid, to send traffic to another site to listen to music

premises.text: Built-in analytics and A/B testing infrastructure lets customers measure lift in engagement, retention, and revenues from music
premises.evidence_span: we also have the necessary analytics and A-B test infrastructure for you to quickly determine if there is lift in engagement, retention, and revenues

premises.text: Self-service pricing at $25 per month lets sites, apps, and games stream popular music
premises.evidence_span: For the price of $25 per month, you can get popular music streaming on your website, app, or game

value.text: B2B customers increase engagement, retention, and revenues by adding legal music to their products
value.evidence_span: we're a B2B play focused on building engagement, retention, and revenues for our customers

notes: Legal pain and music-lift claims folded as one desirability/barrier premise (§4.1.6).
